sentences.text: This creature featured two rows of bony armor plates along its back, with additional plates protecting its belly.
Its hand structure was unusual, as the fourth digit stretched further than the middle fingers.
Teeth lined the entire length of its long snout, challenging the idea that relatives possessed beaks.
Remains were uncovered in the 1960s, marking the first find of an aetosaur in this specific rock layer.
Scientific analysis suggests its feeding habits differed significantly from those of most other members of its group.
Its jaws were capable of moving faster but lacked the strength found in other relatives.
Experts hypothesize it consumed soft-bodied colonial insects and small vertebrates.
Taxonomically, it is placed within the subfamily Desmatosuchinae and the family Stagonolepididae.
It inhabited the Los Colorados Formation in La Rioja, Argentina, during the Norian stage, between 227.3 and 205.7 million years ago.
